_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: the slope at a point — the tangent
the derivative pair — function and its rate
velocity as the derivative of position
the vector field — flow at every point
partial derivative — rate along one axis
the FTC bridge — derivative and integral

voltage.after: the slope at a point — the tangent
voltage.why: the projector that flattens a 3D artifact into 2D abstraction — makes VISIBLE the representational choice a plain tangent-plot hides, the derivative is a picture we agree to draw.

voltage.after: the derivative pair — function and its rate
voltage.why: the rule f -> f' shown as CODE beside the curve — the derivative as an executable operator, notation and machine as one substrate.

voltage.after: the vector field — flow at every point
voltage.why: bodies dragged by the field before any force is named — flow-before-force, the QFEP move that the field is prior to the object it carries.

voltage.after: velocity as the derivative of position
voltage.why: the player's own walk written as a line — velocity as biography, the derivative of a body that is YOU, not a puck on a track.
